title: Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement — Days Past Due on a Shortfall Notice
content:
Days past due add to the late charge rate on a shortfall notice the employer is liable for. They are counted in calendar days from the notice's due date to today:

| Calendar days from the notice's due date to today | Percentage points added to the rate |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 0.5 |
| at least 10 but fewer than 30 | 0.25 |
| fewer than 10 | none |

The due date is the cure due date recorded on the employer-liable shortfall notice under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement.

Boundary cases (hypothetical): a notice due 30 calendar days before today takes 0.5 points; one due 29 days before today takes 0.25; one due 10 days before today takes 0.25; one due 9 days before today takes none.
